response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrated experience in agentic AI systems at scale, fintech infrastructure, or regulated AI deployment, with no evidence of multi-agent architecture, real-time credit/risk systems, or leadership scaling engineering teams beyond 10 people — all hard requirements for the role.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering background with diverse tech exposure
Active open-source contributions and tooling development
Experience with event-driven systems and distributed architectures
concerns: No proven production experience with multi-agent AI frameworks or LLM orchestration
Lacks fintech-specific domain knowledge in credit, liquidity, or compliance systems
No evidence of leading or scaling engineering teams to 30+ or governing hybrid external teams
